name: LV Up
doc: LV Up (the command): the root and the play task - the level-up layout on the target (its morphing model, the target measured), the sound; the action result when it ends. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag271_lv_up.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pool in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Root
parts.doc: The level-up layout on the target (its morphing model, the target measured), the sound; the action result when it ends

params.label: Main
params.doc: The prim-model layout main (its models' animation)
